Fresh rg -uu --follow scans in original checkout and current 218 included ignored/hidden files, excluding only .git and .venv. Two retained research mentions and ignored DRAM module alternatives were read and distinguished; no maintained exact pathway was found. This is the declared identity/reaction/PMID search, not source exhaustion.

All five native objects, 29 stoichiometric sides and selected left-to-right pathway traversal were independently checked from original XML. RXN-11236 and RXN-15838 reaction records are reversible; native pathway layout selects the represented traversal. Other-species controllers are explicitly excluded rather than transferred.

Seven selected native small compounds match ChEBI InChI/formula/charge in the retained original SQL. Five original-source atom/charge balances and the compartment-aware net pass independently. c551 and generic c-type carriers remain distinct unchanged formal classes; no full protein molecular formula or energetic pumping proof is inferred from balance. Rhea class comparisons retain their broader scope and compartment limits.

All 13 selected current UniProt entries map to PAO1 taxon 208964. Gene deletion/physiology and structural preparations are not upgraded to exact purified current sequences. Original RCSB polymer records identify natural PAO1 but NorB lacks current residue R301 and NorC has K100 versus current N100; both differences remain explicit. E. coli complementation and non-isogenic IHF mutant evidence are bounded.

NarG/H/I and NorB/C are qualified functional ensemble roles, not claims that individual subunits alone catalyze complete reactions. Inspected native complexes belong to other taxa and are not reused as PAO1 assemblies. No unsupported exact transporter-to-antiport enables relation or heterologous complex identity is asserted.

Fe-S, Mo-bisMGD, hemes, copper and calcium assertions preserve current entry evidence codes and structural preparation scope. The 2010 primary Fig. 4 discussion supports exclusion of NorB proton pumping despite a conflicting current similarity annotation. c551 is not promoted to the unique physiological donor for all terminal reductases; azurin is not required by the inspected 1997 abstract. Strict antiport versus uniport remains unresolved.

Expression-level Anr, Dnr and NarL effects are separated from catalysis and iMod context. The Anr source assertion needs Results paragraph 2 for its motif experiment; the NarK1 source-local annotation is generic membrane and does not alone establish the stated cell/inner-membrane specificity. These are the two issue407 findings, not refutations of the pathway.
